name: track_then_log
title: First day · "track what I eat" gets a table at once, and "log two eggs" a row

steps.reply:
I've made a Food log, in a new Food module. It's empty so far.

Each entry holds:
- the food
- when you ate it
- the meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack or drink)
- the quantity
- calories, protein, carbs and fat
- where the numbers came from

To log something, just tell me, for example "two boiled eggs and toast for breakfast". I'll look up the nutrition from a label or a site where I can. If I have to estimate a home-cooked portion, I'll mark it as an estimate and say what I assumed.

What have you eaten today?

I logged two eggs as a snack at 21:50: 143 kcal, 12.6 g protein, 0.7 g carbs and 9.5 g fat. The numbers are USDA values for a large whole egg (72 kcal each), doubled. I recalled them from memory rather than checking the USDA site just now.

I assumed large eggs, cooked with no added oil or butter, and eaten as a snack. If they were fried in butter, a different size or a different meal, tell me and I'll fix the entry.
